title: Yesu awakubali wakosa
chorus:
Tangazeni kwa bidii,
“Akubali wakosa!”
Liwe neno dhahiri,
“Akubali wakosa!”

stanzas.text:
Yesu awakubali,
Wakosa, wahalifu,
Wambieni wa mbali
Habari ya wokovu.

Awakubali Bwana
Neno lake amini
Watu kila aina
Waje kwake tengoni.

Mimi ni safi moyo
Na mbele ya sharia,
Aliye safi roho
Kwake ilitimia.
